entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter, a Speaker and dream interpreter of Femeref who tends the Efravan refugees and leads their escape into an old mine, then wins the magistrate over.

entities.name: Pallar
entities.description: A pregnant Efravan leonin and Zar's sister, who gives birth to a daughter named Lark.

entities.name: Zar Ojanen
entities.description: A strong Efravan warrior and descendant of Jaeger and Jedit Ojanen, who leads the caravan's flight.

entities.name: Sidar Teshunda
entities.description: The aged magistrate and general of Femeref, who bars the Efravan until Niambi's dream interpretation and the sight of the refugees move him to accept them.

entities.name: Awateh
entities.description: A councilman and historian who stokes fear that the Efravan are Phyrexian sleeper agents.

entities.name: Gbega
entities.description: A councilwoman who supports refusing aid to the Efravan.

entities.name: Jabras
entities.description: A portly councilman who supports refusing aid to the Efravan.

entities.name: Esbo
entities.description: A guard at the magistrate's estate whom Niambi persuades with a dream.

entities.name: Denik
entities.description: Niambi's husband, who helps the Efravan escape through the abandoned mine.

entities.name: Kequia
entities.description: Niambi's teenage daughter, whose name means fighter.

entities.name: Lark
entities.description: Pallar's newborn daughter, born in the mine.

entities.name: Mabutho
entities.description: Niambi's son, who helps the Efravan in the mine.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Niambi's father, a planeswalker, referred to by Awateh.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: A prophet who saved Femeref during the Mirage War, whose bust inspires Niambi.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: The wizard who tried to conquer Northern Jamuraa in the Mirage War.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian whose legacy Awateh invokes in his accusations.

entities.name: Jaeger and Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Champions of Jamuraa from whom Zar descends.

entities.name: Efravan
entities.description: Nomadic leonin tribes who flee the southern war and wait outside Femeref's walls.

entities.name: Council of Voices
entities.description: The ten-member ruling council of Femeref, which at first refuses to aid the Efravan.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The feared invaders, whose supposed sleeper agents drive Femeref's prejudice.

entities.name: Phyrexian machine
entities.description: A gargantuan mechanical creature that emerged from the desert sand and is marching on Femeref.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: The walled city of Jamuraa where the Council of Voices rules.

entities.name: Great Chamber
entities.description: The circular chamber where the Council of Voices meets.

entities.name: Great Desert
entities.description: The desert of Jamuraa through which the Efravan have wandered.

entities.name: Abandoned gold mine
entities.description: A secluded mine beyond the city wall where the Efravan hide and Pallar gives birth.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: The war in which Kaervek tried to conquer Northern Jamuraa and Asmira saved Femeref.

events.summary: Niambi examines Pallar, who asks why she risks the magistrate's displeasure by helping the Efravan, and Niambi tells her a dream of birds and a diseased tree.
events.quote: I saw a flock of birds searching for a home over a vast ocean.

events.summary: Niambi recalls protesting the decree against aiding the Efravan before the Council of Voices.
events.quote: Three days prior, Niambi held audience with him and the Council of Voices in the Great Chamber

events.summary: Awateh and the councilors claim the Efravan may be Phyrexian sleeper agents, and Teshunda sides with them.
events.quote: "There are Phyrexians out there, hiding in plain sight behind the wall!"

events.summary: Teshunda has Niambi escorted out of the Great Chamber and refuses to help the Efravan.
events.quote: "Out!" Teshunda shouted, driving Niambi back on her heels.

events.summary: Zar reports a tunnel to the abandoned mine is complete, and the Efravan plan to flee that night; Niambi insists on one more attempt with the magistrate.
events.quote: "When night falls and the first stars shine, we will move."

events.summary: Niambi uses her glowing hands and a dream story to persuade guards to let her into the magistrate's estate.
events.quote: Touched by her words and the sun magic running through them, the guards allowed her through.

events.summary: Niambi learns the magistrate has not slept and finds him at the Great Chamber, where she asks about his dreams.
events.quote: to find the magistrate seated upon a fountain in the courtyard.

events.summary: Teshunda tells Niambi he dreamed the tree was himself and refused the little bird's help; she offers to take him to meet the bird.
Niambi drives away with the magistrate in a carriage as Awateh, Gbega and Jabras try to stop them.
At the mine, Pallar has given birth to Lark; Niambi reunites with her husband and daughter and brings Teshunda to see the Efravan.
Teshunda recognizes Zar as a descendant of Jaeger and Jedit and decides the Efravan will stay in Femeref.
events.quote: You will stay here with us."

events.summary: Teshunda silences the councilors and welcomes the Efravan to Femeref.

relations.note: Niambi is called daughter of Teferi.

relations.quote: "Mother," came a small voice from the shadows
Denik, her father and Niambi's husband
Lark is her name," Pallar replied.

relations.note: Presides on a raised throne as magistrate.
Accuses them of being Phyrexian sleeper agents.
relations.quote: Who's to say one of these Efravan, whom you so ardently protect, is not a possessed wanderer
"Descendant of Jaeger and Jedit, champions of Jamuraa?"

relations.note: She brings them aid and saves them.
relations.quote: "You have been such a friend to the Efravan,"
in the Great Chamber to protest a decree handed down to the people of Femeref
